[ tail_utility(third hand, grasping, bracing, counterbalance); ear_motion(unified pair, single-ear swivel only for lateral sounds); ]

12.content: Water dramatically alters the weight and silhouette of a fur coat. Under a running shower or heavy rain, dense fur saturates quickly, darkening in shade, growing heavy, and clinging tightly to the body to outline muscle contours underneath. Heavy droplets gather at the tips of flattened ears, run down the bridge of the muzzle, and cling to whiskers. Drying off requires a vigorous full-body shake, thorough rubbing of the undercoat with a thick towel, and warm airflow to restore volume. [ wet_fur(heavy darkened fur clinging to muscles, droplets on ear tips and whiskers, undercoat towel and blow-drying); ]
